scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:web"
scripts.db:migrate:local: docker compose -f compose.local.yml exec -T postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U arap -d arap -f /migrations/001_initial.sql -f /migrations/002_document_status_and_retrieval_trace.sql
scripts.dev:local: bun run infra:local && bun run db:migrate:local && (kill -9 $(lsof -t -i:${PORT:-3001}) 2>/dev/null || true) && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "bun run dev:api:local" "bun run dev:web:local"
scripts.typecheck: bun --cwd=apps/api run typecheck && bun --cwd=apps/web run typecheck
